comment: Single source of truth for the 模型动态 slice. Drives three things that must
never disagree: the deterministic permalink (ASCII, so links are stable and
shareable), the sidebar order (the upstream generator sorted by birthtime, which
a fresh clone cannot reproduce), and the model -> article table that the
ai-model-world 查看评测文章 button resolves against.
models lists the snapshot model slugs for which THIS article is the answer.
Exactly one article may claim a model; an unclaimed model falls back to the
collection page rather than being guessed at. Every slug below was checked
against data/models.json, not inferred from the filename: naive matching links
GPT-5 to the GPT-5.6 article, and GPT Images 2.5 has no snapshot model at all
(the closest are GPT Image 2.5 Flare / Sunburst, which this article is not
about), so it is deliberately left unclaimed.
